focus: 主持會議的開場收線與結論
lead: 今天練的是你自己當主持人：開場給地圖、把跑掉的討論拉回來、把結論釘死。心法 —— 主持人的工作不是講最多話，而是控制「現在在談什麼」和「誰負責什麼」。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Three things today, and here’s where the time goes.
phrases.gl: 今天三件事，時間這樣分（開場先給地圖，大家就不會亂跑）
phrases.ex: Three things today, and here’s where the time goes: five minutes on collection hours, twenty-five on the calibration failures, five on the labeling queue.

phrases.en: Before we open that up — are we deciding today, or just aligning?
phrases.gl: 先界定這題今天是要「決定」還是只是「對齊」（很多會議失控，是因為沒人講清楚今天要幹嘛）
phrases.ex: Before we open up the storage question — are we deciding today, or just aligning? If we’re deciding, I need Vincent in the room.

phrases.en: Let me stop you both there.
phrases.gl: 我先把你們兩位打住（乾淨的打斷，比連說三次 sorry、excuse me 更有主持力）
phrases.ex: Alan, Kevin — let me stop you both there. We’re eight minutes into root cause and we still haven’t decided whether those two cars go out Monday.

phrases.en: Let’s park that and come back to it.
phrases.gl: 這題先擱著，之後再回來（park 是母語主持人的標準動作，不是敷衍，重點是要附上「什麼時候回來」）
phrases.ex: Let’s park the rolling shutter debate and come back to it Monday, once Alan has the static mount test.
phrases.fix: 取代 “Let’s discuss about it next time”

phrases.en: That’s a two-person conversation — can you take it offline?
phrases.gl: 這是兩個人的事，請私下談（把細節討論踢出會議，但一定要指名是哪兩個人）
phrases.ex: That’s a two-person conversation — Alan, Kevin, can you take it offline and bring one answer back Monday morning?

phrases.en: I haven’t heard from you on this.
phrases.gl: 這題我還沒聽到你的意見（主動點名安靜的人，比空泛的 anyone else? 有效十倍）
phrases.ex: Ivy, I haven’t heard from you on this, and it lands on your queue — does a Monday slip break your labeling schedule?

phrases.en: Let me play that back so I know we agree.
phrases.gl: 我複述一次，確認我們理解一致（回放是主持人最值錢的一招，當場逼出隱藏的不同意）
phrases.ex: Let me play that back so I know we agree: four cars go out Monday instead of six, and Rachel re-plans around that today.

phrases.en: So the decision is X, the owner is Y, and the date is Z.
phrases.gl: 決定、負責人、日期三件套（少了任何一樣，這場會議就等於沒開）
phrases.ex: So the decision is we hold the two cars, the owner is Alan, and the date is Monday nine a.m.
phrases.fix: 取代 “OK so we will follow up on this”

phrases.en: We’re at time — two things are still open, and I’ll send them out after this.
phrases.gl: 時間到了，還有兩件沒收，我會後補（準時結束是一種信用，下次大家才願意準時來）
phrases.ex: We’re at time — the storage decision and the calibration sign-off are still open, and I’ll send them out after this.

setup: Setup. You chair the Friday data and model review — forty-five minutes, eight people, ten o’clock. Three things are on the agenda: this week’s collection numbers (you hit 62 of the 80 planned highway hours), a calibration failure on two of the six instrumented cars, and the labeling vendor queue, which is now nine days deep. Alan from hardware and Kevin from perception disagree about whether the soft footage is rolling shutter or a loose camera mount, and they have been circling that for eight minutes. David, the program manager, joins at ten-thirty and wants one thing: whether the cut-in recall target still holds for the next platform build. Last week this same meeting ran twenty minutes over and ended with no owners assigned.

prompts.q: It’s ten o’clock. Eight people are on the call, David joins at ten-thirty, and last week this meeting ran twenty minutes over with nothing decided.
prompts.frame: State the clock and the length → name the three items in order → say where the time goes and why → say what you need out of the meeting → hand off to the first person by name.
prompts.say: 出聲把開場一次講完（目標 30 秒）。不要用 “So… um… maybe we can start?” 開場，主持人的第一句要是宣告，不是徵求同意。
prompts.model: “Okay, it’s ten — let’s start. Forty-five minutes, three things: collection hours, the calibration failures, and the labeling queue. Most of the time goes to calibration, because that’s the one that blocks next week’s drives; the other two I want in about three minutes each. David joins at ten-thirty and he’s going to ask one question — whether the cut-in recall target still holds for the next build — so I want an answer ready for him, not invented live. What I need out of this meeting is three owners and three dates. Rachel, start us off: where did we land on hours?”

prompts.q: Alan and Kevin are eight minutes into arguing about rolling shutter versus a loose mount. Four other people have gone completely quiet.
prompts.frame: Interrupt cleanly → say what this room actually has to decide today → park the root-cause debate with an owner, a channel and a date → pull in someone you haven’t heard from, with a specific question.
prompts.say: 出聲練「把跑掉的討論拉回來」。重點是打斷之後馬上給方向，不要打斷完就沉默。
prompts.model: “Alan, Kevin — let me stop you both there. You’re debating root cause, and that is the right debate, it’s just not one this room can settle in five minutes. Here’s what we actually have to decide today: do those two cars go out Monday, yes or no. So let’s park root cause — Alan, you and Kevin take it offline, run the static mount test over the weekend, and bring me one answer by Monday nine a.m. Put it in the thread, not another meeting. Ivy, I haven’t heard from you and this lands on your queue: if those two cars go out Monday and the footage comes back soft, does that break your labeling schedule, or can you absorb it?”

prompts.q: It’s ten forty-two. David wants his recall answer and two items are still unresolved.
prompts.frame: Call the time → play back each decision as decision plus owner plus date → name what’s still open and who closes it → answer David with a confidence level and a trigger → close and give the follow-up time.
prompts.say: 出聲把結尾講完（目標 45 秒）。禁止用 “we will follow up” 收尾 —— 每一條都要有名字和日期。
prompts.model: “We’re at ten forty-two, so let me close this out. Let me play it back so I know we agree. One: Alan owns the mount-versus-rolling-shutter test, answer by Monday nine a.m. Two: those two cars are held until that answer, so Rachel, you’re re-planning Monday and Tuesday around four cars, not six. Three: Ivy pulls the highway batch forward so the vendor queue doesn’t sit idle — she confirms that by end of day. Still open: who signs off on the new calibration procedure, and whether we buy more storage or delete the June rosbags. I’ll take both to David and come back Monday. David, on your question — the recall target still holds, and my confidence is around seventy percent, because it depends on the calibration fix not costing us a week. If it slips past Wednesday, I’ll flag it that day rather than wait for the next review. Anything anyone wants to flag before I let you go? Okay — notes out in twenty minutes. Thanks, everyone.”

fixes.bad: Let’s discuss about the storage budget in next week meeting.
fixes.good: Let’s take the storage budget at next week’s meeting.
fixes.note: Grammar / Preposition：discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不要加 about；in next week meeting 要改成 at next week’s meeting（時間點用 at，週次用所有格 ’s）。

fixes.bad: Because Kevin is still training the model, so we don’t have the number today.
fixes.good: We don’t have the number today because Kevin is still training the model.
fixes.note: Grammar：「因為…所以…」是中文結構直譯，英文只能留一個連接詞 —— 要嘛 because，要嘛 so，兩個一起放母語者會覺得句子壞掉。

fixes.bad: Maybe we can try to see if it’s possible to get more vehicle slot next week.
fixes.good: I need two more vehicle slots next week. Rachel, can you confirm by Tuesday?
fixes.note: Vagueness / Plurals：maybe、try to、see if 三層 hedge 疊起來，聽起來像可以被忽略的願望。主持會議時要給數字、對象和日期。slot 是可數名詞，兩個以上要加 s。

fixes.bad: I think everyone already understand this topic, right? So we can pass it.
fixes.good: I think we’re aligned on this — anything anyone wants to flag before I move on?
fixes.note: Grammar / Register：everyone 當主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞要 understands。另外 pass it 在會議裡不通，母語者說 move on；而且與其問「大家懂了吧？」，不如給一次明確的反對窗口。

fixes.bad: The meeting is very long, until now we still not decide the calibration owner.
fixes.good: We’re running long, and we still haven’t decided who owns calibration.
fixes.note: Tense：「到現在還沒」要用現在完成式 still haven’t decided；until now 是中式時間副詞，直接省略。we still not 缺助動詞，一定要 haven’t。running long 也比 very long 更像會議用語。

challenge:
今天在你主持的任何會議或群組討論，做到這兩件事：

  • 開場第一句就給地圖：“Three things today, and here’s where the time goes: ___.”
  • 結尾必須出現三件套：“So the decision is ___, the owner is ___, and the date is ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：假設兩位工程師已經吵了八分鐘的技術根因，你要把會議拉回來。

  • 用一句乾淨的打斷開場（Let me stop you both there），不要連說三個 sorry
  • 明講「這個房間今天真正要決定的是什麼」
  • 把根因討論 park 出去，並附上負責人、管道和日期
  • 結尾點名一位還沒發言的人，問一個具體問題（不是 any comments?）
  • 禁用：discuss about、maybe we can try to see if、Because…, so…、we will follow up
check: 我開場的第一句，有沒有讓所有人知道今天幾件事、時間怎麼分、要產出什麼？
討論跑掉的時候，我是等它自己燒完，還是出聲 park 掉並指定負責人和日期？
散會前，我有沒有把每個結論講成「決定＋負責人＋日期」，而不是「我們再追蹤」？
